sn12.23:1.2: jānato ahaṃ bhikkhave, passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi. no ajānato no apassato.
sn12.23:1.3: kiñca bhikkhave jānato kiṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti?
sn12.23:1.4: “iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṃgamo,
sn12.23:1.8: iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṃgamoti”.
sn12.23:1.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhave jānato evaṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn12.23:2.1: yampissa taṃ bhikkhave, khayasmiṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ, tampi saupanisaṃ vadāmi. no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:2.2: kā ca bhikkhave khaye ñāṇassa upanisā?
sn12.23:2.4: vimuttimpahaṃ bhikkhave saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:2.7: virāgampahaṃ bhikkhave saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:2.10: nibbidampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:2.13: yathābhūtañāṇadassanampahaṃ bhikkhave saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:2.16: samādhimpahaṃ bhikkhave saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:3.3: sukhampahaṃ bhikkhave saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:3.6: passaddhimpahaṃ bhikkhave saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:3.9: pītimpahaṃ bhikkhave saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:3.12: pāmujjampahaṃ bhikkhave saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:3.15: saddhampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:4.3: dukkhampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:4.6: jātimpahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:4.9: bhavampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:4.12: upādānampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:4.15: taṇhampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ.
sn12.23:5.2: vedanātissa vacanīyaṃ. vedanampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ. kā ca bhikkhave, vedanāya upanisā?
sn12.23:5.3: phassotissa vacanīyaṃ. phassampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ. kā ca bhikkhave, phassassa upanisā?
sn12.23:5.4: saḷāyatanantissa vacanīyaṃ. saḷāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi. no anupanisaṃ. kā ca bhikkhave saḷāyatanassa upanisā?
sn12.23:5.5: nāmarūpantissa vacanīyaṃ. nāmarūpampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi. no anupanisaṃ. kā ca bhikkhave nāmarūpassa upanisā?
sn12.23:5.6: viññāṇantissa vacanīyaṃ. viññāṇampahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanisaṃ vadāmi. no anupanisaṃ. kā ca bhikkhave viññāṇassa upanisā?
sn12.23:5.8: saṅkhārepahaṃ bhikkhave, saupanise vadāmi, no anupanise.
sn12.23:7.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, upari pabbate thullaphusitake deve vassante taṃ udakaṃ yathāninnaṃ pavattamānaṃ pabbatakandara padarasākhā paripūreti. pabbatakandara padarasākhā paripūrā kusobbhe. paripūrenti, kusobbhā paripūrā mahāsobbhe paripūrenti, mahāsobbhā paripūrā kunnadiyo paripūrenti. kunnadiyo paripūrāyo mahānadiyo paripūrenti. mahānadiyo paripūrā mahāsamuddaṃ paripūrenti.
sn12.23:8.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, avijjūpanisā saṅkhārā. saṅkhārūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ. viññāṇūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ. nāmarūpūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ. saḷāyatanūpaniso phasso. phassūpanisā vedanā. vedanūpanisā taṇhā. taṇhūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ. upādānūpaniso bhavo. bhavūpanisā jāti. jātūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ. dukkhūpanisā saddhā. saddhūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ. pāmojjūpanisā pīti. pītūpanisā passaddhi. passaddhūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ. sukhūpaniso samādhi. samādhūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ. yathābhūtañāṇadassanūpanisā nibbidā. nibbidūpaniso virāgo. virāgūpanisā vimutti. vimuttūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇanti.
